name: [2310.08560] MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
snippet: Using this technique, we introduce MemGPT (Memory-GPT), a system that intelligently manages different memory tiers in order to effectively provide extended context within the LLM's limited context window, and utilizes interrupts to manage control flow between itself and the user.
